name: Vi
title: the Piltover Enforcer

Q.name: Vault Breaker
Q.description: Begin Charging: Vi begins charging a powerful punch, Slowing herself by 15%. Release: Vi dashes forward dealing between 40/60/80/100/120 + 0.6×bonus AD and (40/60/80/100/120 + 0.6×bonus AD) × 2.5 physical damage based on charge time and applying Denting Blows to all enemies hit. Vi stops upon colliding with an enemy champion, and Knocks them Back.
Q.summary: Vi charges her gauntlets and unleashes a vault shattering punch, carrying her forward. Enemies she hits are knocked back and receive a stack of Denting Blows.

W.name: Denting Blows
W.description: Passive: Every 3rd Attack on the same target deals an additional (4/5/6/7/8 + 0.035×bonus AD) × 0.01 max Health physical damage, removes 20% Armor and grants Vi 30/35/40/45/50% Attack Speed for 4 seconds. It also reduces the remaining Cooldown of Blast Shield by @spell.ViPassive:CDReductionOn3Hit@ seconds.
W.summary: Vi's punches break her opponent's Armor, dealing bonus damage and granting her Attack Speed.

E.name: Relentless Force
E.description: Vi's next Attack deals 10/35/60/85/110 + 1.1×AD + 1×AP physical damage to the target and enemies behind them. This Ability has 2 charges ((varies) second refresh).
E.summary: Vi's next attack blasts through her target, dealing damage to enemies behind it.

R.name: Cease and Desist
R.description: Vi singles out an enemy champion, revealing them and dashing unstoppably towards them. Upon reaching them, Vi Knocks them Up for 1.3 seconds and deals 150/250/350 + 0.9×bonus AD physical damage. Any other enemies Vi collides with are dealt damage, knocked aside, and Stunned for 0.75 seconds.
R.summary: Vi runs down an enemy, knocking aside anyone in the way. When she reaches her target she knocks it into the air, jumps after it, and slams it back into the ground.

Passive.name: Blast Shield
Passive.description: Vi charges a shield over time. The shield can be activated by hitting an enemy with an ability.
Passive.summary: Vi charges a shield over time. The shield can be activated by hitting an enemy with an ability.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Diver jungler who charges Q to dash and knock enemies back, then locks one target with an unstoppable point-and-click R. Wins ganks and teamfights by picking the carry she chooses.
strengths: R is point-and-click, unstoppable and knocks up: very reliable lock-down
Q charged dash knocks back and starts ganks from range
W every 3rd hit shreds armor and gives attack speed
Passive shield triggers when her abilities hit
weaknesses: Q charge is telegraphed and slows her while charging
Short range: kited when Q is down
Falls off as a damage threat late
R commits her deep; often dies after using it

curve.lvl1: medium – E double charges clear, weak duels
curve.lvl2: strong – Q dash + E burst for ganks
curve.lvl3: strong – Q/W/E gank combo with armor shred
curve.lvl6: strong – R locks the carry for her team
curve.items: strong – first AD item (Eclipse, Sundered Sky or Black Cleaver)
curve.late: medium – pick tool more than a carry

profile.curveNote: Ganks from 3 with Q/W/E; R makes every gank and teamfight reliable.

Passive.notes: Shield activates when her abilities hit.

Q.notes: Charge (slows herself), then dash; knocks back the first champion hit.

W.notes: Every 3rd attack: max-health damage, armor shred, attack speed.

E.notes: Empowered attack hitting enemies behind the target (2 charges; dodgeable by Jax E).

R.notes: Point-and-click unstoppable dash; knocks up the target and knocks aside others.

profile.windowAgainst: Q on cooldown (no gap closer) or after R is used: punish her, she's committed.
